blockers.blocker: The frozen v0 boundary is exactly 160 f32 samples per process call; it cannot express r<1 output expansion in device time.
blockers.reopen: A versioned variable-frame playback actuator or a caller-owned TSM FIFO with explicit source/output timestamps outside v0.
blockers.scope: Slow-down (0.95x) is measured only in the task-local whole-clip fixture. The optional C reference covers identity and 1.25x/1.5x speed-up only.

blockers.blocker: No target-device pacing, fill/flush, CPU, memory, deadline or availability measurement was run.
blockers.reopen: Paced workload on the intended target with fill/flush, deadline misses and resource telemetry under the intended profile.
blockers.scope: All numbers are deterministic synthetic-fixture observations.

blockers.blocker: No listening test, real-speech or real-music corpus, intelligibility score or release-quality assessment was run.
blockers.reopen: Held-out permitted speech/music, matched controls and authorized listening/intelligibility scoring with rights review.
blockers.scope: All stimuli are analytic surrogates; Praat/psola package results in the linked research are source-reported context, not reproduced here.

blockers.blocker: The C provider is unregistered, opt-in and not part of the installed SDK or any descriptor registry.
blockers.reopen: Explicit provider intake, rights/license review, versioned public surface decision and independent review before any promotion.
blockers.scope: No public API, ABI, descriptor registry, default, installed behavior, shared CMakeLists.txt or main was changed.

contract.overlap_add: Hann windows with per-sample denominator normalization

frequency_scale.interpretation: PSOLA overlap/add preserves the pitch of the synthetic pitch marks; linear resampling is an adverse pitch-shifting control.

pitch_marking.definition: absolute-value local maxima with minimum separation

slow_r_whole_clip.interpretation: r<1 expansion is measured only in this task-local whole-clip fixture; the fixed 160-sample v0 process call cannot emit more than 160 valid samples and is not used for slow-down.

chunking_equivalence.reason: Pitch marking needs one sample of lookahead; a mark at a frame boundary can appear after the next frame is delivered, so the whole-clip and causal 160-frame histories are distinct.

music_like.note: Sample-adjacent discontinuity proxy only. No listening, transient audibility score or naturalness claim is made.

unfamiliar_speech.note: Sample-adjacent discontinuity proxy only. No listening, transient audibility score or naturalness claim is made.

unvoiced_fallback.interpretation: No pitch marks; no voiced synthesis is invented.
